title: Harden the exact node-5 segmented router replay hierarchy
hypothesis: Removing synthetic PPA stimulus and hardening the exact replay top will produce a reusable intrinsic router anchor whose routed netlist can accept the verified Llama7B activity without hierarchy substitution.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What intrinsic PPA and workload energy does the exact node-5 router consume without synthetic harness logic?
include: four virtual channels and depth-four FIFOs
routed artifacts for matching VCD power
exclude: aggregate mesh links and clock tree

expected_benefit: separate router logic from harness overhead
replace vectorless scaled router energy in the Llama7B transport cost
risks: wide direct macro pins can limit floorplanning
one interior node does not measure inter-router wiring or spatial activity variation
1.8 ns may remain infeasible after harness removal

required_evaluations.objective: Measure intrinsic Nangate45 PPA for the exact node-5 router hierarchy used by the verified Llama7B replay.

expected_result.reason: The r7 router-plus-harness result cannot accept the bare-router replay VCD as exact workload power evidence.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require canonical replay-source identity, a logic-free node-5 specialization, complete PPA, timing feasibility, retained routed artifacts, and explicit path identity. Do not claim aggregate mesh or endpoint/SRAM energy.
